THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH  ORAL JUDGMENT 1.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. This appeal is filed by the claimant assailing the Judgment and award dated 30.09.2023 passed in MVC No.262/2022 by the III Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT-XII, at Vijayapura (for short 'the Tribunal'), awarding compensation.

entities.text: III Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT-XII, at Vijayapura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. For the sake of convenience, the parties will be referred to as per their ranking before the Tribunal.

4. Having taken note of the submission made by the learned counsel for the parties, it is not in dispute that the NC: 2026:KHC-K:1090 HC-KAR claimant has sustained grievous injuries on account of the road traffic accident on 04.01.2022.
The claimant has examined the treating Doctor as P.W.2 to assess the disability of 8%.

It is also to be noted from the grievous injuries sustained by the claimant as per the wound certificate marked at Ex.P.3 and also taking into account the monthly income of the claimant as Rs.14,750/- per month by following the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, and also in the light of the Judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Hitesh Nagjibhai Patel Vs. Bababhai Nagjibhai Rabari and another, reported in 2025 Livelaw SC 871, the loss of earning capacity of the claimant would be Rs.2,54,880/- (Rs.14,750/- X 12 X 18 X 8%).

entities.text: Hitesh Nagjibhai Patel Vs. Bababhai Nagjibhai Rabari and another, reported in 2025 Livelaw SC 871
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence, the award of compensation is re-
assessed as follows:
Sl. No.

2 Rs.54,000/- 5
Conveyance charges Rs.20,000/- 6 Special diet Rs.20,000/-

 NC: 2026:KHC-K:1090  HC-KAR 5.
(iii) The respondent No.2-Insurance company is directed to deposit the compensation amount along with interest within six weeks from the date of this order.
